data.title: The Brass Bolt
data.text: You reached the sea, and The bolted stone at Vell Foot is intact. Tomas Lind set a brass bolt into the boulder in 1979 so he could measure the glacier from a fixed point. He measured the ice from there every September. The survey hut at Vell Foot is intact too. A new note on its door says that someone went to look for the stakes, could not find them, and left the tea. I do not know the writer. I know the kettle is still on the shelf. That is a small thing to preserve, but the hut has always made room for walkers.
